description: Does robots.txt allow fetching this exact URL? Fetches the live robots.txt and applies the longest-match rule for a user agent (default: * plus GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, CCBot, PerplexityBot). Returns allowed or not, the rule that decided it, and any crawl delay. A courtesy check, not a legal opinion.

url.description: The full URL you want to fetch

name: can_fetch
